cards.text: Friend, this one's heavy, so stay close. Jehu, the man just anointed king over Israel (2 Kings 9:6), has shot Joram king of Israel (2 Kings 9:24), and his men have shot Ahaziah king of Judah (2 Kings 9:27). Joram was the son of Ahab, an earlier king of Israel (1 Kings 16:29; 2 Kings 3:1), and Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria, so Jehu writes letters to the officials, the elders and the guardians of Ahab's sons.
Jehu's letter starts out like a checklist. Your master's sons, chariots, horses, a fortified city, weapons: check, check, check, CHECK, CHECK.

cards.question: With all those chariots and weapons in Samaria, what does Jehu's letter tell the officials to do?

answers.text: Crown the best son and fight for Ahab's house
Send the seventy sons away to Judah
Hand their chariots and horses to Jehu

cards.question: The officials in Samaria get ready to fight Jehu.
The officials are terrified. They reason that if ___ kings could not stand against Jehu, there's no way they can.

cards.text: So the palace administrator, the overseer of the city, the elders and the guardians send Jehu a message: "We are your servants, and we will do whatever you say." Chariots, horses, a whole fortified city, and they fold like a lawn chair.

cards.question: When the officials of Samaria send their answer back to Jehu, what do they promise they will NOT do?

cards.text: Then Jehu writes them a second letter. If you're on my side and you'll obey me, here's what I want at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.

cards.question: Jehu's second letter tells the officials to bring him the heads of their master's ___.
When Jehu's second letter arrives, the leading men of Samaria do what Jehu says.

cards.text: This is a hard one to read, friend. They kill all seventy of the king's sons and send their heads to Jezreel in baskets, and Jehu orders them piled in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning.
Next morning, Jehu goes out and stands before all the people. Friend, you could hear a crumb drop.

cards.question: Standing before all the people, what does Jehu admit he did?

answers.text: Conspired against his master and killed him
Sent his men to burn down Samaria
Broke his promise to the elders

cards.text: Jehu tells the people they're innocent. Then he points at those heaps and asks, "But who killed all these?"

cards.question: Jehu says not a word the LORD spoke against the house of Ahab will fail. Through which servant of His had the LORD promised it?
In Jezreel, Jehu strikes down not only what's left of Ahab's house, but also Ahab's great men, close friends and priests.

cards.text: Then Jehu sets out toward Samaria. At Beth-eked of the Shepherds, he runs into some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah, and he asks the question you never want to hear from a man like Jehu: "Who are you?"

cards.question: What do Ahaziah's relatives tell Jehu they've come down to do?

answers.text: Greet the sons of the king and the queen mother
Carry King Ahaziah's body back home
Join Jehu on his march to Samaria

cards.text: I think nobody has told these men the news. Jehu orders, "Take them alive."

cards.question: Jehu lets some of Ahaziah's relatives go home to Judah.

cards.text: His men slaughter them at the well of Beth-eked, forty-two men in all. Friend, some moments you don't rush past, and this is one of them.

Leaving there, Jehu finds Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him, and Jehu greets him and asks, "Is your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours?" Friend, after everything Jehu's done on this trip, that is NOT a casual hello.

cards.question: Jehonadab tells Jehu that his heart is true.
Jehu asks Jehonadab for his hand. Once Jehonadab gives it, what does Jehu do with him?

answers.text: Helps him up into his chariot
Sends him on ahead to Samaria
Makes him a commander of troops

cards.question: As Jehu helps Jehonadab into his chariot, what does Jehu invite Jehonadab to come and see?

cards.text: Jehonadab's in the chariot, and the next stop is Samaria. There, Jehu strikes down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained, until he has destroyed them.

cards.question: Jehu strikes down everyone left in Samaria who belonged to Ahab, according to the word the LORD had spoken to Elijah.

cards.text: That's all for this batch, friend. Jehu's chariot is still rolling, and his story keeps going.
